cover_letter.greeting: Dear NBCUniversal Production & Operations Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst, Production & Operations role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that this role covers both the monthly numbers for Rockefeller Center Operations and the capital budget plans with the project team.

At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and reconciliation work where we reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At Lenovo I built forecasts, models and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I'm SAP certified and work in Excel and PowerPoint every day.

Consolidating actuals against budget, helping the Finance Manager close each month and building better tracking files for space allocations and capital plans all build on that background. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
